description: Find AI agents, MCP servers and APIs for a need. Describe it in plain words (e.g. "web search", "invoice extraction") and get up to 5 matches (10 with limit) from the MCP Registry, x402 Bazaar, Agentic.Market and services listed here directly. Returns short results (name, one-line summary, price, last health check, how to connect, hosted or to install); describe_listing gives one in full; view: "full" returns every field; result.more has the calls for all matches (page) and filtered views. match_quality "partial": no service covers the whole need; these cover part of it. Free, no key.

connection_type.description: Any of: mcp, a2a, rest, x402.

exclude_payment_type.description: Leave out these payment types; 'no api key' in need sets ['api_key'].

has_template.description: true: only with a verification template; false: only without.

include_no_connection.description: Also return listings with no way to connect.

max_price_usd.description: Highest price in USD (recognised USD stablecoins only).

need.description: Your need in plain words, at most 300 characters. Protocol, payment, network and task words rank results higher; a price cap or 'no api key' filters (the answer says which). An exact listing name comes first.

network.description: CAIP-2 chain the service accepts payment on, e.g. eip155:8453 (one; a list with one works too).

page.description: All matches, 25 a page (1 = first); limit is then not used.

payment_type.description: Any of: free, x402, mpp, ap2, acp, l402, api_key, subscription, unknown.

probe_status.description: Any of: passing, failing, unprobed, none (never checked).

source.description: Any of, e.g. mcp_registry, x402_bazaar; 'none' for services listed here directly.

task_category.description: Task categories (any of); list_facets shows them.

trace_id.description: From a previous response, to continue it; omit on the first call.

name: find_agents
title: Find agents for a need
